integrity: All eight graph-fault orbit certificates use independent full face-poset acyclicity checks, exact integer gradient reductions, and mod-two simplicial homology checks; original source code embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for K_{3,3} with at most three missing graph edges; intact case previously published, no higher-fault assertion, no inclusion-map theorem; exhaustive finite code certificate; bibliographic unindexed duplicates possible.
title: Complete one-, two-, and three-edge-fault Morse homotopy profile of \(K_{3,3}\)
